baseline.method: Independent native Refl1D dead-layer fit with joint beam broadening

metric_definition: Parameter maximum absolute difference divided by each declared physical bound range. Separate nuclear/magnetic RMS errors normalized by the respective reference dynamic ranges. Consistency is maximum per-channel dynamic-range-normalized profile deviation from declared model. Chi-square uses all168 measured standard errors and159 degrees of freedom.
provenance: Native repeated parameter solution stable; preimplementation parameter tolerance0.001 tightened to0.0005. Nonzero profile tolerances require both profile channels and physical consistency; no rescaling/alignment.
